conclusions.unification: interface subclauses (c)=item 2 and (e)=item 4 both reduce to the location/gap of mu_L (~0 zeta, O(1) plant). The README's 'front A2 build-neutral by nature' label is incorrect: mu_L-dependence smuggles the discriminant into the interface.
